name: hanoi
description: 汉诺塔 HANOI — 浏览器原生汉诺塔. 32 张 LOT（含 10 张线柱）的最少步数全部由穷尽 BFS 量出，并与 2^n−1 / Frame-Stewart / 线柱 3^n−1 闭式对账；最大图 1,594,323 态.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js server.cjs electron/main.cjs tools/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK
scripts.unit: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run bake:check && npm run unit

author: z-biz-game
